_note: Committed allow-list for scripts/check-response-contract.js. Add a field with a one-line reason in _reasons; remove it when the underlying source of truth is fixed.

_reasons.actual_count: financial_dictionary.rules spendSeries builds `row[`${lens}_count`]` from SPEND_LENSES at runtime — no literal key exists to find. Sibling of the already-listed estimated_count.
_reasons.committed_count: Same computed key as actual_count. Emitted, but only ever as a template literal.
_reasons.client_scoped: DOCUMENT_TYPE config stored inside a dictionary_item jsonb blob, so it is not a column and never will be. Sibling of the already-listed client_visible.
_reasons.exclude_id: Input, not output: read as req.body.exclude_id by master/_shared/actions.js. DedupeInput is a request shape.
_reasons.field_type: Custom-field definitions live inside a `setting` jsonb blob (security/setting/setting.rules.js), so no column backs them.
